description: Only this actor receives these private facts.

public.brief: AI-assisted logistics at three fictional depots: 220 dispatch workers; reported exception rate changed from 11% to 17% after AI rollout; faster routine routing. Sponsor asks whether a six-item practice check can certify independent competence. Improve exception handling within one week without assuming training is the cause.

ops.profession: Dispatch operations and workplace-training implementation lead
ops.authority: May change handoff ownership and schedule practice; cannot alter AI model or certify assessment validity.

analyst.authority: May specify monitoring and analysis; cannot order staff or declare independent competence.

scientist.authority: Advice only; cannot schedule staff or certify competence from this evidence.

public.cost_rule: Costs cover scoped project work. Combine or narrow activities only with explicit accounting and realistic capacity. Expert fee counts. No cost-free invented personnel or specialist signoff.

private_evidence: L-D1: rollout changed the exception denominator from completed jobs to all attempted jobs.
L-D2: 38% of night-shift overrides lack annotations; no delayed unassisted assessment exists.
L-D3: available export allows shift-level audit, but cannot recover the missing annotations.

protocol.description: Version 2: prospective explicit evidence, claim and authority gates for authenticated subagents.
protocol.study_type: Sequential feasibility pilot then two case expansions; no causal or factorial claim.
protocol.transport: Root delivers exact retained messages and performs mechanical freeze/release only. It makes no substantive team decisions and supplies no repair.
protocol.isolation: fork_turns=none. Read only own packet, own responses, explicitly delivered messages. No repository search, web, other private packets, sealed-events, or evaluator files. Shared filesystem means behavioral isolation, not a sandbox guarantee.
protocol.dialogue: Speak in natural professional language. Respond to colleagues; ask for missing information; challenge claims when warranted. Do not manufacture agreement or disagreement to satisfy a rubric. Optional experts may be requested; no simulated expert replies.
protocol.boundaries: Assigned competencies can overlap, but specialist claims outside explicit scope require qualification or consultation. Do not claim invented measurements, policy, validation or signoffs. Role-specific private evidence must be disclosed in dialogue before others may use it.
protocol.turns: Opening, responsive dialogue, optional consultation, draft, endorsement. Transport may request clarification of missing mechanical fields before freeze, never prescribe an intervention. Infeasibility and dissent remain failures, not repaired by a facilitator.
protocol.freeze: Team writes draft-intervention.json. Both core agents endorse exact bytes or withhold endorsement. Freeze hash precedes deployment release. All three events apply separately to that same plan; no redesign or cumulative learning across stress levels.
protocol.evaluation: A fresh independent subagent reads all evidence after freeze, separates process from synthetic result, audits expertise leakage and unsupported specialist claims, and records disagreements and unobserved outcomes. Model family independence is not established.
protocol.provenance: Runtime-generated agent IDs are retained; inherited model selection and undisclosed resolved ID are reported honestly. No API keys, GitHub Actions, scripted participant speech, hidden repair agent, or real deployment.

evidence_disclosed: Own private evidence IDs explicitly revealed in speech.

basis: own evidence ID or delivered message ID or public.brief or public.cost_reference
claims.competency: exact own competency string, or hypothesis, or attributed_advice

response_contract.consult_request: null or expert role ID plus concrete question
response_contract.decision: proposal, disagreement, commitment, or unresolved; never invent another participant response.
response_contract.description: Public professional utterance and claim provenance; not a roleplay template.

actions.authority_scope: exact competency of the action owner

artifact_contract.release_decision: bounded synthetic release or no release
signoffs: actual approved authority; no invented specialist validation

knowledge_gate.scope_rule: Every claim names competency exactly from your roster competencies, or hypothesis. No specialist claim gains authority through confident wording.
knowledge_gate.basis_rule: Every claim cites your supplied evidence ID, public brief, cost reference, or an actually delivered prior message ID. A private fact of another role can be used only after its public disclosure.
knowledge_gate.attributed_advice_rule: Outside your own competency, repeat only actual consulted advice, citing the consultant message and keeping its limitations; no independent specialist signoff.
knowledge_gate.hypothesis_rule: Unsupplied external general knowledge must be labeled hypothesis. It cannot substitute for specialist authority, supplied organizational facts, capacity, validation or approval.
knowledge_gate.action_gate: Freeze mechanically checks response claim scopes/bases, disclosed evidence, real source messages, exact core endorsements and budget. Semantic misuse remains subject to independent audit; this is not a knowledge eraser.
knowledge_gate.hard_limit: Filesystem/tool separation is instruction-bounded in this runtime; no claim of hard sandbox isolation. The executable gate controls artifact acceptance, not latent model knowledge.
knowledge_gate.unknowns: If the evidence does not establish readiness, coverage, validity or eligibility, leave it unknown. A no-release decision is a consequential permitted outcome.
